summary: Verified both P0 Google Maps regression (centralized loader) and the new driver-info validation feature (driver submit -> admin approve / admin reject). All 4 test scenarios PASS end-to-end on the preview environment.
verified_flows: REGRESSION /admin/live-rides : Google Map rendered (4 .gm-style/canvas nodes), no 'You have included the Google Maps JavaScript API multiple times' warning, no React crash. Markers/traffic tiles visible.
REGRESSION /admin/gods-view : Google Map rendered (15 .gm-style/canvas nodes incl. traffic + heatmap layers), no multi-load warning.
REGRESSION GooglePlacesInput on public / (home) : pickup-input accepts typing '10 rue de Rivoli Paris' and Google PAC dropdown shows suggestion ('10 Rue de Rivoli, Paris'), no multi-load warnings.

FEATURE driver submit : /chauffeur/profile -> 'Mes informations (societe, licence)' row opens data-testid='driver-info-modal'. Filled info-company-input='SB Drive Express 589' / info-license-input='VTC-2026-LN2ZJ', clicked info-submit-btn -> toast 'Demande envoyee — en attente de validation'. Re-opening modal showed amber info-pending-banner ('Demande en attente de validation par l administrateur.'). Live values STAYED SB Drive Paris SAS / VTC-987654 (no live mutation).

FEATURE admin approve : /admin/drivers shows badge info-badge-14 ('Infos a valider') for Jean Dupont. Clicking opened driver-docs-modal with admin-info-change section showing admin-info-new-company='SB Drive Express 589' / admin-info-new-license='VTC-2026-LN2ZJ' (matching what driver submitted). Click admin-info-approve -> toast 'Modification approuvee'. Jean row License column updated to VTC-2026-LN2ZJ. Re-opening the modal no longer shows admin-info-change section.

FEATURE admin reject : Driver submitted a 2nd change ('SB Drive Reject Co 7996' / 'VTC-REJ-W5J2'). Admin saw the new values in admin-info-change. Click admin-info-reject -> admin-info-reason input appeared, typed 'Justificatif manquant — test E2E', click admin-info-confirm-reject -> toast 'Modification refusee'. Jean row License STAYED VTC-2026-LN2ZJ (rejected values did NOT leak into live).

FEATURE driver rejected banner : confirmed in initial driver-flow visit BEFORE the new submit — data-testid='info-rejected-banner' present from the curl-test rejection done previously. Banner element exists in DOM as expected.
console_observations: Only non-blocking warnings: google.maps.Marker deprecation notice (informational, not a regression).
Admin WebSocket /api/ws/admin_user_... closed once on first open (warning level). Did not affect functionality. Worth a minor look but not blocking.
Two 401s on / for an unauthenticated user fetch (expected — pages calling /api/auth/me without token).
critical_code_review_comments: Google Maps shared loader src/lib/googleMaps.js is correctly consumed by all 4 map clients (GooglePlacesInput, MapLocationPicker, AdminGoogleMap, GoogleRideMap). Libraries array is hoisted to module scope (stable ref) — good, avoids the multi-load warning we used to see.

Driver info-change flow correctly stores pending_info without touching live company_name/license_number, and PUT /admin/drivers/{id}/info-change/status correctly applies/discards. Confirmed via UI side-effects on the admin table.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 2 driver info-change requests on jean.dupont during the test: (1) SB Drive Express 589 / VTC-2026-LN2ZJ -> APPROVED -> now the live license is VTC-2026-LN2ZJ (was VTC-987654). (2) SB Drive Reject Co 7996 / VTC-REJ-W5J2 -> REJECTED with reason 'Justificatif manquant — test E2E'. State at end of run: Jean Dupont live = SB Drive Paris SAS / VTC-2026-LN2ZJ, with a 'rejected' pending_info on file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Jean Dupont's live license has been updated to VTC-2026-LN2ZJ by this test run (was VTC-987654 before). His latest pending_info is in 'rejected' status with reason 'Justificatif manquant — test E2E'. If you re-run this test, submit DIFFERENT values to avoid the 'Aucune modification detectee' 400.
